vulnerabilities.description: HMAC token signature validation is stubbed: function loads buffers but never performs actual HMAC-SHA256 comparison. Returns true unconditionally. Allows injection/tampering of authentication tokens.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

vulnerabilities.description: Weak PBKDF2 key derivation: only 100,000 iterations. NIST recommends minimum 600,000 iterations for 2026 standards. Degrades resistance to brute-force attacks on session encryption keys.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

vulnerabilities.description: Fallback to plaintext storage when WebCrypto unavailable: session data (including tokens) stored unencrypted in localStorage. Exposes sensitive authentication tokens to XSS and localStorage compromise.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

vulnerabilities.description: Global token exposure: authentication token stored in window.__IMPECCABLE_TOKEN__ accessible to all scripts on page. Vulnerable to XSS, malicious third-party scripts, and browser extensions.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

vulnerabilities.description: Unvalidated localStorage JSON deserialization: parsed session object never validated for expected structure. Attacker controlling localStorage could inject malicious session objects.

Math.random() fallback for security-relevant IDs: if crypto.randomUUID unavailable, falls back to Math.random() which is not cryptographically secure. Could be used to generate predictable session/token identifiers.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

vulnerabilities.description: Race condition in concurrent session writes: localStorage operations lack transaction/locking. Multiple tabs/windows could experience data corruption or lost updates to session state.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization

vulnerabilities.description: Localhost port validation allows HTTP injection: port regex allows 4-5 digit numbers. If injection script runs on exposed interface or behind misconfigured proxy, enables HTTP request smuggling attacks.
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

vulnerabilities.description: No Content Security Policy bypass detection: injected script doesn't validate that it operates within CSP constraints. Could be bypassed with malformed CSP headers.
Silent failures in storage operations: safeRead/safeWrite/safeRemove silently catch all exceptions. Error conditions (quota exceeded, private mode) not surfaced, may lead to silent data loss.

recommendations: CRITICAL: Implement actual HMAC-SHA256 verification in validateTokenSignature() using crypto.subtle.verify() before loading injection script
CRITICAL: Increase PBKDF2 iterations from 100,000 to minimum 600,000 (RFC 2898, NIST SP 800-132)
CRITICAL: Remove plaintext fallback in createPlaintextStorage(). Fail secure instead: throw error if WebCrypto unavailable rather than silencing encryption
CRITICAL: Move TOKEN from global window object into module closure. Expose only validated session ID, never raw token
HIGH: Add schema validation for deserialized session objects before use (e.g., check for required properties, types)
HIGH: Replace Math.random() fallback in id8() with crypto.getRandomValues() only, with hard error if unavailable
HIGH: Implement transactional session storage: use versioning/checksums to detect concurrent write races
MEDIUM: Tighten port regex to explicitly allow only localhost: validate target origin before making requests
MEDIUM: Add CSP validation: ensure injected script respects (or detects violation of) current page CSP
MEDIUM: Surface storage errors explicitly instead of silently failing: log quota exceeded, private mode detection, enable user remediation
MEDIUM: Encrypt localStorage content even if WebCrypto available (defense in depth): do not rely on XSS isolation alone
LOW: Implement auto-rotation of PBKDF2 salt on each session: prevents rainbow tables if salt ever leaks
